text_block_list.text:
“Still, I managed to place
and fought hard all the way to the end.”

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
"This means I'm really getting stronger, right,
Trainer?!"
choice_data_list: That's proof of all your hard work every day!
That's proof of all your hard work every day!
We've got to work even harder.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Eheh...
It's all thanks to your guidance, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
“Still, there's always someone better above us.
I can't just take this loss lying down!”

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
...I feel power welling up inside me!
I'm gonna keep giving it my all! Yeah!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Ugh... So you think so too,
Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
"My goal is to become the best Umamusume in Japan...
I can't afford to be satisfied with just this."

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
All right, let's get fired up and do our best
starting tomorrow too! Yeah!
